div.div:
Failures
• Site takes 30 s: abort at 10 s, nack(timeout), Frontier doubles the host pause. A slow host takes 1 slot out of ~200.
• Worker died: the 60 s lease expires, the URL returns to the queue. S3 PUT is atomic, the event is sent only after the write.
